name: Kaedehara Kazuha
notes: Both sources' support build agree: 4pc Viridescent Venerer, EM on all three, ER sands as an option, Freedom-Sworn first, Burst first. KQM adds that his Skill level matters little (Character Level > Burst > Normal Attack = Skill). Game8 also lists a DPS build (ATK% or EM sands, Anemo DMG goblet, CRIT circlet, Mistsplitter Reforged) which is left out. KQM's ER depends on his weapon and on how many Skills the team casts: 1 hold Skill 220-280 (other swords), 2 Skills 160-200 (Freedom-Sworn or other swords), 125-150 with Favonius Sword; 150 is used as the middle for a team with two Skills. Neither source gives other goals. Partners: any swirl-able element.
